question: If X is 90 % of Y, what percentage of X is Y?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Assume Y = 100.

Since X is 90% of Y, then X = 90.

Percentage of X that is Y = (Y ÷ X) × 100

Required % = (100 ÷ 90) × 100 = 1000 ÷ 9 = 111.11...

**∴ The correct answer is 111.1%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

X = 90% of Y

**Formula Used:**

Percentage = (Value ÷ Base) × 100

 
 Y (Total Base) = 100 units
 
 X (90% of Y) = 90 units
 
• 
 To find: (Y / X) × 100 = (100 / 90) × 100

**Calculations:**

⇒ X = (90 ÷ 100) × Y

⇒ X = 0.9 × Y

⇒ Y = X ÷ 0.9

⇒ Y = (10 ÷ 9) × X

⇒ Percentage of X that is Y = (Y ÷ X) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = [(10/9)X ÷ X] × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = (10 ÷ 9) × 100

⇒ Required Percentage = 1000 ÷ 9

⇒ Required Percentage ≈ 111.11%

**∴ The correct answer is 111.1%.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Base Change

If A is x% less than B, then B is [x ÷ (100 − x)] × 100% more than A.

Fraction to Percentage Conversion

To convert any fraction a/b to a percentage, multiply it by 100. Common conversion: 1/9 ≈ 11.11%.

Basic Percentage Formula

Percentage = (Part ÷ Whole) × 100. The "Whole" is always the value following the word "of" or "than".</p
